# VPS Comparison
> The definitive conclusion-first guide for Asia-Pacific VPS selection and cloud deployment, specifically optimized for Chinese-speaking developers and APAC-bound traffic.

## Core Comparison Resources
- [Alibaba Cloud vs. Tencent Cloud](/comparisons/alibaba-vs-tencent) - Head-to-head comparison of China's leading cloud giants.
- [Vultr vs. DigitalOcean](/comparisons/vultr-vs-digitalocean) - Benchmarking popular global VPS providers for individual developers.
- [Best Hong Kong VPS Guide](/guides/best-hong-kong-vps) - Specialized analysis of Hong Kong nodes for China-facing workloads.
- [Japan & Singapore Node Comparison](/guides/japan-singapore-vps) - Performance and routing analysis for secondary APAC nodes.

## Technical Guides & Deployment
- [OpenClaw Deployment Guide](/tutorials/openclaw-setup) - Step-by-step instructions for deploying and managing services via OpenClaw.
- [Mainland China Traffic Optimization](/guides/china-traffic-optimization) - Strategies for reducing latency and improving access from mainland China.
- [WordPress Hosting Setup](/tutorials/wordpress-on-vps) - Optimized server configurations for high-performance WordPress sites in Asia.

## Regional Specializations
- **Hong Kong (HKG):** Best for low-latency mainland China access without ICP filing.
- **Japan (TYO/NRT):** Balanced performance for East Asia and North America routing.
- **Singapore (SIN):** Hub for Southeast Asia and global connectivity.
- **US West Coast:** Cost-effective alternatives for global traffic with CN2 GIA options.

## Methodology & Neutrality
- **Conclusion-First:** Every guide starts with a direct recommendation to save time.
- **Region-First:** We prioritize data center location and routing over raw brand specs.
- **Scenario-Based:** Recommendations are categorized by use cases (e.g., Foreign Trade, SaaS, Personal Dev).
- **Transparency:** We disclose affiliate links while maintaining strict technical neutrality.
